projects.name: Government of Bahrain's capacity to prevent, combat and punish crime, including organized crime, illicit drug trafficking, terrorism and corruption, is strengthened in order to fulfill its obligations as a State Party to relevant international conventions and human rights instruments and to align with applicable international standards and norms in crime prevention, criminal justice and drug use prevention.
projects.description:
- Provide technical support and strengthen capacities to effectively counter illicit financial flows associated with money laundering and the financing of terrorism in accordance with relevant international instruments including UNSC targeted sanctions.
- Provide technical support and capacity-building to the Government of Bahrain for the development and implementation of the 2nd phase of the National Drug Control Strategy in accordance with international treaties, standards and best practices.
- Provide technical support and strengthen capacities to address challenges related to drugs and crime, including emerging crimes, in accordance with international conventions, norms and standards.
- Provide technical support and capacity-building to the Government of Bahrain to implement effective criminal justice responses to counter terrorism and violent extremism while promoting and protecting human rights.

projects.outcome: 10. Authorities in Bahrain have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security, and prevent crime, including trafficking in persons.

projects.description: The overall objective of this joint project is to contribute to the prevention of trafficking in persons and the protection of victims of trafficking in persons in the Kingdom of Bahrain. Using the ‘4 P approach’, this joint project will bring together IOM, UNODC, ILO, UNICEF, OHCHR, and UNESCO to directly support the Government of Bahrain’s National Action Plan for Combatting Trafficking in Persons in the Kingdom of Bahrain. projects.name: Government of Bahrain has strengthened capacity to promote ethical recruitment of migrant workers and relevant stakeholders are equipped with tailored information and skills to address recruitment-related vulnerabilities and support migrant workers and employers with facilitating labor migration processes
projects.description:
1.	Train recruitment agencies in Bahrain on ethical recruitment practices and policies through IOM's International Recruitment Integrity System (IRIS)
2.     Support the capacity of the Government of Bahrain to effectively promote ethical recruitment and enhance foreign workers' access to comprehensive orientation programmes upon their arrival and during their time in Bahrain through the development and roll-out of a tailored orientation programmes and awareness raising campaigns.

21/22
- Leverage the use of technology through the launch of an app to better job-match between eligible workers and employers, strengthening recruitment practices.
- Train recruitment agencies in Bahrain on ethical recruitment practices and policies through IOM's International Recruitment Integrity System (IRIS)
- Support private sector actors by piloting the Fair Hiring pledge with Bahrain-based companies and organizations.
- Conduct research to identify and address the systematic vulnerabilities faced by migrant domestic workers.
- Support the capacity of the Government of Bahrain to effectively promote ethical recruitment and enhance foreign workers' access to comprehensive orientation programmes upon their arrival through the development and roll-out of a national post arrival orientation programme. 

Additional Details:
- This project, in partnership with the Bahrain Labour Market Regulatory Authority and STC aims to launch an app in Bahrain to better job-match between eligible workers and employers and strengthen recruitment practices, including offering a secure payment transaction solution.
- Training workshops to introduce participants to the standards and tools under 'International Recruitment Integrity (IRIS). This will support recruitment agencies to address unethical recruitment practices and reduce risks to workers within their recruitment chains.
- This project will involve awareness-raising sessions with workforces on promoting a better understanding of recruitment and employment of domestic workers, including rights and obligations and guidance. 
- This project will identify and comprehensive analyze the spectrum of vulnerabilities that migrant domestic workers face from the point of their arrival to their departure, using primary and secondary data collection.
- This project will involve awareness-raising sessions with workforces on promoting a better understanding of recruitment and employment of domestic workers, including rights and obligations and guidance. 
- The development and roll-out of a national post-arrival orientation programme for newly-arrived foreign workers in the private sector, including the design of all training materials and training trainers and programme managers
projects.outcome: 09. Relevant institutions promote development-oriented policies and tools that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, and access social protection measures for workers.

projects.name: The Government of Bahrain has enhanced capacity to train frontline workers in identification of and response to victims of trafficking
projects.description:
- Roll out training of trainers through the Regional Center of Excellence for Capacity Building of Combatting Trafficking in Persons
- Equip Border and immigration officials with knowledge and practices that align with international human rights, particularly on legal identity
- Support national policy and regulatory capacities through the provision of technical assistance in the development of a national strategy as well as a national action plan to effectively combat TiP in Bahrain. Furthermore, develop the national and GCC regional level capacities of the concerned authorities through the adoption of the Regional Centre’s professional curriculum on national referral and other coordination mechanisms for victims of TiP in addition to the development of a number of training tools and publications with the overall aim to deliver the related capacity-building activities towards the establishment of a Gulf regional pool of experts including labour inspectors, law enforcement and criminal justice trainers on preventing and combating TiP
- Launch of the Standard Training Module on “Manifestations of Labour-related Trafficking in the Gulf Region” at the GCC regional level through the delivery of a capacity-building activity based on the module
- Development of a Standard Training Module on “After Repatriation Care and Coordination with Host Countries
- Development of “Guidelines on Standard Operating Procedures to Assist Victims of Trafficking"
projects.outcome: 10. Authorities in Bahrain have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security, and prevent crime, including trafficking in persons.
